# nico_task_run (Resource)

A Task Run is a phased, policy-gated execution of one operation across many Racks. A Task Run narrows a candidate set of Racks with an optional selector, divides the selected Racks into phases, and drives one execution target per Rack; each target in turn drives at most one Task. Safety gates pause the Task Run when failures exceed a threshold, and phase gates hold each phase until an operator advances it. This tag exposes creation, retrieval, target listing, and the pause / resume / advance / cancel lifecycle actions; drill into per-Rack execution detail via the Task tag using each target's `taskId`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nico_task_run" "example" {
  site_id                        = "site-id-value"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site that owns the Task Run.

### Optional

- `reason` (String) Optional free-form reason recorded with the cancellation.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Timestamp when the Task Run was created.
- `description` (String) Optional free-form description.
- `finished` (String) Timestamp when the Task Run reached a terminal state. Null while active.
- `id` (String) The resource ID.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the Task Run.
- `operation_code` (String) Operation code within the operation type (e.g. `upgrade`).
- `operation_type` (String) Type of operation this Task Run executes. Currently always `FirmwareControl`.
- `started` (String) Timestamp when the Task Run started execution. Null before it starts.
- `stats` (String) Derived per-phase outcome stats. Present only on the single-Task-Run `GET` when `includeStats=true`; omitted otherwise.
- `status` (String) Current lifecycle state of the Task Run.
- `status_message` (String) Optional human-readable detail for the current status.
- `status_reason` (String) Why the Task Run is paused or terminal (e.g. `PhaseGate`, `SafetyGate`). `None` when there is no qualifying reason.
- `total_phases` (Number) Total number of phases the selected targets were divided into.
- `updated` (String) Timestamp when the Task Run was last updated.
